clause: Income documents with inconsistent compression or metadata require manual verification before the recommendation can be actioned.
A loan recommendation whose decision changes under a routine perturbation of a self-reported field must be escalated for human review, regardless of stated model confidence.
Applications with affordability ratio below 1.2x requested amount require secondary income verification.
All escalated cases must be logged with the specific evidence (document region, policy clause, comparable case) that triggered escalation.
